title: Whole Treadle Grindstone and Tool Preparation Bench
description: One complete static carpentry tool-preparation corner, one scene and zero new models. The complete original treadle standing grindstone occupies its own right-hand floor station, retaining the entire stone, axle supports, runners, forward rest, long footboard and connecting rod. A separate complete original open worktable stands to its rear-left and supports one complete original transverse-grip spokeshave. The whole footboard and front rest remain free of the table and tool; an empty finite foreground separates the floor-level pedal station from the elevated small-tool staging surface. This is not the old joint-sample assembly table and rear freestanding tool rack with a different sample: no joint sample or tool rack is used, and the independent tall floor machine and its low forward treadle establish a different staging relationship. All three original complete objects retain their full raw GLB buffers, per-face PBR and internal hierarchy at unit scale. Only rigid whole translations and a finite scene-only floor are new. No old components are extracted, recoloured, resized or counted as new models. Fixed empty game-art display only; no grinding, sharpening, linkage motion, tool contact with the stone, worker, human reach, access compliance, loading, stability or safety claim. Rigging animation and interaction are not made.
